_comment: Traditional Chinese texts for the German table solenne. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_TW.

strings.Sand howls through the wind towers: ever: 沙子在風塔間呼嘯：前排所有非Stone屬性的Spirling每回合損失少量元氣。
strings.Take the sand road south from the Saltgl: 從Saltglass平原沿沙路南下前往Ochrewell，修復Solenne的三道裂隙。
strings.Teaches Dawn Mend to a Lumen Spirling. N: 教會Lumen屬性Spirling Dawn Mend。永不消耗。
strings.Teaches Radiant Lance to a Lumen Spirlin: 教會Lumen屬性Spirling Radiant Lance。永不消耗。
strings.Teaches Squall to a Gale Spirling. Never: 教會Gale屬性Spirling Squall。永不消耗。
strings.The last shutter opens, the tower breath: 最後一扇百葉窗開啟，塔開始呼吸，樓梯暢通了！
strings.The oasis east of Ochrewell has run dry:: Ochrewell以東的綠洲乾涸了：綠洲裂隙。守境者Kaia說這不怪任何人。
strings.The oasis has been sold dry: every heal: 綠洲被賣幹了：雙方所有治療減半。
strings.The shutter bangs, and the wind drops de: 百葉窗砰地一響，風一下子死了。所有百葉窗又關上了。
strings.The shutter swings open. Sand hisses thr: 百葉窗開啟了。沙子從縫隙間嘶嘶湧入。
strings.The shutters hum in the wind. The stair: 百葉窗在風中嗡嗡作響。樓梯一直開著。
strings.The sun stands straight overhead: Lumen: 太陽正當頭頂：雙方的Lumen技藝打得更狠。
strings.The sundial under the sun palace has sto: 太陽宮下的日晷停了：太陽裂隙。守境者Emrys在等著，慢慢地。
strings.The wind towers of Ochrewell have stoppe: Ochrewell的風塔停止了呼吸：高塔裂隙。守境者Aurelio哀傷得很有格調。
